description: The new wrapper does not supply the metrics attribute consumed by shared initialization.
trigger: Use nonempty overrides with -lm/--load_metrics and reach the metrics block.
expected_behavior: Print loader metrics and return initialized objects.
actual_behavior: config.stc.metrics.print() accesses a missing attribute: the wrapper skips the base constructor and initializes only main and stcs.

verification.description: Compared the complete wrapper changes with the unchanged metrics consumer. The caller search locates shared initialization in six evaluation/example scripts; imgsearch directly calls init with arguments built by add_args.
verification.limits: Source-derived, conditional on reaching the metrics block; not executed.

introductions.rationale: This commit introduces the new override wrapper and installs it in shared initialization; the wrapper lacks metrics while the consumer reads config.stc.metrics.
